articles.title: Bigg Boss Kannada 13: Wild card entrant Kumari gets evicted after a short stint in the house
articles.summary: Bigg Boss Kannada Season 13 witnessed another eviction during the weekend episode, with wild card entrant Kumari bidding goodbye to the house.
articles.body: Bigg Boss Kannada Season 13 witnessed another eviction during the weekend episode, with wild card entrant Kumari bidding goodbye to the house. Having entered the reality show just a few weeks ago, Kumari's journey came to an end within a short span of almost three weeks, leaving her fellow contestants emotional.This week's elimination process saw seven contestants nominated for eviction: Asiya, Dhanush, Gagan, Jagadeesh, Kiran, Kumari and Prashant. After the elimination proceedings, Kumari was announced as the contestant leaving the house.During her eviction, Kumari got emotional and admitted that she could not live up to the expectations viewers had of her. She acknowledged that she might not have delivered the kind of performance the audience anticipated, making her exit an emotional one.From Agnipareekshe to the Bigg Boss house: Kumari's journeyKumari's journey on Bigg Boss Kannada 13 was particularly special, as she was not a regular celebrity contestant but someone who had already caught the audience's attention through the reality show Agnipareekshe.A 20-year-old from Nanjangud, Kumari made a mark on Agnipareekshe with her straightforward nature and unfiltered way of expressing herself. She reportedly became the first contestant on the platform to receive the green signal from all four judges, making her a popular face among viewers even before entering the Bigg Boss house.Although she did not make it to the final stage of Agnipareekshe, fate had another opportunity waiting for her. Following the exit of Sangeetha Bhat and Modern Mahakavi Manja from Bigg Boss Kannada 13, Kumari was given a second chance to showcase her personality and talent as a wild card entrant.She entered the Bigg Boss house alongside fellow Agnipareekshe contestant Lakshmi during the festive Dasara period. From participating in the initial tasks to gradually finding her place among the housemates, Kumari began a new chapter in her reality television journey.A short journey that left an impressionDespite her relatively short stint, Kumari managed to build connections inside the house. Her innocent demeanour, candid conversations and straightforward approach made her a contestant who stood out in her own way.Her interactions with fellow housemates also brought out an endearing side of her personality. She gradually became part of the household dynamics, and her presence was acknowledged by contestants who shared a warm bond with her.However, the past week proved challenging for Kumari. She was reportedly dealing with health issues, which affected her participation in the tasks. Her limited involvement during this crucial phase may have also affected her journey in the competition.Her eviction was an emotional moment for the housemates, with several contestants visibly affected by her departure. For someone who had entered the show with hopes of making the most of her second opportunity, the journey ended sooner than expected.While Kumari admitted that she could not meet the audience's expectations, her Bigg Boss journey gave her an opportunity to reach a wider audience beyond Agnipareekshe. Though her stint was brief, she leaves the house with a memorable experience and the recognition of having made it to one of Kannada television's biggest reality shows.Get the latest TV News, TV Shows and more.
